title: Pico900 Thesis Entry (Farmer-keyed)
description: A single thesis from Pico's 900 Conclusions, identified by Farmer's numbering. Fields render only if graded sourced or unverified by scripts/integrity_gate.py. See docs/EDITORIAL_STANDARD.md section 5.

fields.thesis_id: str (Farmer numbering: '7.2' for section 7 thesis 2 (historical); '4>8' for section 4> thesis 8 (own-opinion))
fields.tier: str enum: 'A' (condemned or heavily discussed, 500-1000 words) | 'B' (identified source and scholarship, 150-400) | 'C' (rest, under 100) | 'D' (not yet researched, Latin and translation only)
fields.section: str (historical section name like 'Averroes' or own-opinion marker)
fields.farmer_line: int (line number in Farmer's Markdown; used to re-derive and verify)
fields.latin: str (full thesis, normalized u/v and i/j, copy-text line noted in apparatus; wrap in lang='la')
fields.latin_source: str enum: 'Farmer 1998' | 'Brown critical edition' | '1486 Rome print' | 'other'
fields.latin_note: str (apparatus criticus: lacunae, conjectures, variant readings)
fields.translation: str (English rendering, original, checked against Farmer's English but not copied; wrap in lang='en')
fields.translator: str ('person name' or 'machine-drafted, human-checked by NAME' with 2026 date)
fields.pico_stance: str enum: 'reports' | 'endorses' | 'revises' | 'reverses' | 'unstated' (Pico's relationship to the thesis)

sources.locator: str (edition and page/section, e.g., 'Aquinas Sent. I.37')

fields.doctrine: str (philosophical argument; define technical terms at first use)
fields.context: str (school debate, setting, why a reader would care or object)
fields.reception: str (commission verdict if condemned, Pico's reply in Apologia, later readers)
fields.historiography: str (named scholars, what each claims with page locators, disagreements)
connections: str (other theses by Farmer id bearing on this one)
fields.condemned_flag: bool (true if one of the thirteen condemned; see data/inventory/condemned_thirteen.json)
fields.commission_verdict: str (exact verdict formula, e.g., 'false, erroneous, heretical')

provenance_grades: sourced (text plus locator, re-found in source by second agent; renders)
unverified (plausible text, no locator or not yet re-found; renders with badge)
misfiled (text in wrong field; never renders)
quarantined (proven wrong by audit; never renders)
missing (field is empty; labeled 'not yet edited')
